description: v2.3.1 (pre-release re-cut #2; replaces the earlier v2.3.1 asset). Adds the v2.3.0 re-cut issue fixes on top of the original v2.3.1 content: the Mereframe integrity hook now logs each distinct native rejection fingerprint once (exception class + message + throwing frame, capped at 12), so the remaining #34 failure mode — no crash, photo taken, but it is not developed into the visible .jpg/.png — can be pinned to the refusing JNI method from a field logcat. Original v2.3.1 content: Table Notes (vivekagarwal.playwithdb 20261111) premium unlock for PDF/Word/Excel export, publishing and the paid set, with the AdMob slots skipped (#29); Netflix (Android TV, com.netflix.ninja) clone, CertCheck, household-prompt, network-fingerprint and in-process ad-remover patch set ported from ajstrick81/morphe-androidtv-patches (GPL-3.0); Mereframe 0.8.4 crash fix, array-length-preserving wrapper guards and the Ul.X paywall short-circuit (#34); Reddit comment TreeData constructor-shape discovery so Show deleted posts and comments applies on every 2026.42.0 build (#35); Amazon Business compatibility and the screenshot-detection patch from PR #31. Verified by building the Android bundle, applying the Table Notes and Mereframe patches to the real APKs and dumping the patched DEX; on-device runtime verification of the new app patches is still pending.
